## What's new

- L2 and R2 jump to the first game of the previous or next letter with each
  press, on every game shelf: each UI Theme, both Game List Views and
  Cubic. A square with the letter fades in over the shelf.
- Holding the d-pad to scroll shows the same square after two seconds,
  with the letter you're passing through. It fades out when you stop.
- The Controls pages list L2/R2.

---

ChaOS 0.10.6 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.10.6-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.10.6-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
